hardware_limits.comment: Absolute servo range. NEVER command within 200 units of these - end-stop stall risk.

GRIP.comment: PROVISIONAL conservative band (center +/-300). NOT calibrated. Widen only after hand-teaching the real mechanical limits with torque off.

safety.comment: Controller does not answer CMD_MULT_SERVO_POS_READ -> NO position feedback, motion is open loop and stalls cannot be detected. Therefore limits must stay conservative and every servo must be unloaded (torque off) when not actively moving.
